svg.title: Weight of Welding and Welded Part
svg.desc: Weight of Welding and Welded Part Calculate the weight of weld metal and the complete welded assembly Calculates the mass of the deposited weld metal and the total weight of the welded part based on the geometry and assigned material densities. Weld Metal Weight: Estimates the mass contributed by the deposited welding material. Welded Part Weight: Calculates the total mass of the final welded assembly. Material-Based Calculation: Uses the assigned material densities to determine the corresponding weight.
